ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI-driven coordinator that links elderly citizens in Mumbai housing societies with verified student volunteer drivers for medical appointments and grocery runs.
ideas.title: SahayakSetu
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses local community care issues in Mumbai and builds on the winning architecture of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A real-time crowd-sourced disaster management and waterlogging alert platform specifically tailored for Mumbai's local municipal wards during monsoon warnings.
ideas.title: AapdaWatch Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a visceral problem that every judge living in Mumbai experiences firsthand during monsoon season, matching the practical impact focus seen in HackCrux winners.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first health assistant providing preventive care, vaccination tracking, and seasonal outbreak alerts in regional Indian languages for semi-urban communities.
ideas.title: ArogyaDoot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning multilingual healthcare strategy of SAGACITY, delivering high social impact and clear presentation clarity.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled walk-to-earn and micro-marketing platform that incentivizes citizens to shop from local Mumbai street vendors and small neighborhood businesses.
ideas.title: LocalLoot Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the Chatswood AI Impact Hackathon winning model to support local urban economies and small vendors, scoring high on practicality and innovation.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered grievance routing engine that categorizes civic complaints from Mumbai housing societies and dispatches them directly to the appropriate municipal ward department.
ideas.title: CivicFlow Ward Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides measurable administrative efficiency and solves a glaring bureaucratic pain point for urban governance in Mumbai.
